startedBy.speaker: Karita
reply: My mother taught me. She was a bard, from the college in Solitude.

startedBy.speaker: Mikael
reply: There's a whole college up in Solitude where they teach the arts. Song. Lute-playing. Poetry.
I studied there myself. Had to leave over a misunderstanding with a headmistress. Well, more a misunderstanding with her husband.

reply: Yes. Congratulations, you are now a full-fledged member of the Bards College.
Due to your adventurous nature several of the college professors have some things they wish you to do.
What's more, Elisif has declared the Burning of King Olaf should become a weekly event.

quests.name: Rjorn's Drum
quests.plugin: JS Instruments of Skyrim SE - Uniques.esp

startedBy.speaker: Giraud Gemane
reply: Rjorn's drum! Nobody knows where he died, and therefore where his drum might be.
Halldir was the missing link. Rjorn entered Halldir's Cairn in secret, and presumably died there.
Now all I need to do is find someone to get it. Wait. You. You could do it. I need you to get me that drum.

why: OnConfigInit runs once when the menu registers in a new game; it sets `migrated` and calls LoadSettings, which goes on only while bEnabled:Maintenance is set (it is 1) and then calls Load, which reads iWTGeneralRequirementsMinimalLevel:Requirements (10, settings.ini in Wyrmstooth - Settings Loader) and sets WTStartLevel to it

MigrateToMCMHelper, which would copy the global's record value (20.0) into that setting, runs only from OnGameReload or OnConfigOpen while `migrated` is false, and OnConfigInit has already set it, so a new game never migrates (an older save made before the loader would)
OnGameReload reloads the settings only when bLoadSettingsonReload:Maintenance is set; it is 0, so later loads keep whatever the global holds
